wholePhysicalScope: The named Upper Castle relation with a surveyed court hole, separate Spanish Hall and Lower Castle footprints, northwest tower and two linked ranges establish the site extent. The wider park remains world terrain.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the Upper and Lower Castle footprints and courts, Spanish Hall, western ranges and green belvedere. Near views add shutters, oculi, chimney stacks and roof dormers.
limitations: The model depicts the standing hilltop complex. The upper court and lower ranges follow their mapped plans. Individual rooms, old grotto interiors and outlying landscape structures are outside the model scope.

Roof pitches, wall sections, floors, patterning, the measured exterior oculus rhythm and masonry relief are architectural estimates tied to the public-domain exterior photographs and documented hall dimensions.
The two structural levels and connecting approaches use the original DEM and the established hill geometry. Hidden foundation details and terrace elevations are approximate.
The ground rises along the southern side of the Lower Castle. The section heights follow that rise approximately while keeping the open inner court and unmodified elevation samples.
